title: Critério de aceite extraído do card

state.description: nao_verificavel = o diff não decide; precisa de registro de pessoa

record.description: where a PERSON's evidence sits; null with not_verifiable blocks. A reviewer's reason never lands here: it goes to `note`

note.description: what a reviewer said about a criterion it could not decide — a reason, not a record; it never passes gate 3

decided_by.description: `suite` when only the suite decides the criterion: it then follows the suite's state, never the absence of a record
